svg.title: koda benchmark: paired ratios against opencode and Hermes Agent
svg.desc: Lollipop chart of tool ÷ koda paired medians on a log scale, run main-20260930, 2026-09-30, deepseek-flash. opencode used less time and money than koda on edit tasks and over all rounds; Hermes Agent used more money and tokens; koda used less than both only on short questions. Wall time (all 42 rounds): opencode 0.66×, koda faster in 2 of 42; Hermes Agent 1.05×, koda faster in 24 of 42; medians 27.0 s / 13.0 s / 27.4 s [KODA TRAILS]; Wall time, edit tasks (20 rounds): opencode 0.64×, koda faster in 2 of 20; Hermes Agent 1.02×, koda faster in 10 of 20; medians 35.5 s / 24.0 s / 35.4 s [KODA TRAILS]; Cost (all 42 rounds, peak basis): opencode 0.92×, koda cheaper in 19 of 42; Hermes Agent 1.67×, koda cheaper in 36 of 42; medians $0.0079 / $0.0052 / $0.0109 [KODA TRAILS]; Cost, edit tasks (20 rounds): opencode 0.76×, koda cheaper in 2 of 20; Hermes Agent 1.21×, koda cheaper in 15 of 20; medians $0.0125 / $0.0099 / $0.0153 [KODA TRAILS]; Cost, questions (e1 + f1, 10 rounds, one-shot in a new directory each ¹): opencode 2.52×, koda cheaper in 10 of 10; Hermes Agent 4.60×, koda cheaper in 10 of 10; medians $0.0015 / $0.0031 / $0.0050 [KODA LEADS]; Input tokens (all 42 rounds, cache hits included): opencode 0.94×, koda lower in 20 of 42; Hermes Agent 2.70×, koda lower in 37 of 42; medians 78,670 / 52,428 / 148,932 [KODA TRAILS]; Input tokens, questions (e1 + f1, 10 rounds ¹): opencode 1.96×, koda lower in 10 of 10; Hermes Agent 4.59×, koda lower in 10 of 10; medians 9,969 / 17,491 / 39,380 [KODA LEADS]; Output tokens (all 42 rounds, reasoning included): opencode 0.77×, koda lower in 12 of 42; Hermes Agent 1.15×, koda lower in 26 of 42; medians 3,871 / 2,107 / 3,843 [KODA TRAILS]; Model calls (all 42 rounds): opencode 0.53×, koda fewer in 1 of 42; Hermes Agent 0.70×, koda fewer in 2 of 42; medians 14 / 7 / 9 [KODA TRAILS]. Speed and calls: koda runs a router, a coder and a verifier one after another, plus a planner and a reviewer when used (a median 20 model calls per edit run against 9 and 12.5), and a failed verification adds a second pass: 3 of 20 edit runs (b1 r1 163 s, d1 r1 126 s, d1 r5 128 s; task medians 35.5 s and 78.6 s). ¹ Each run used a new, randomly named directory. koda's path-free prompts were cached almost whole across runs, the other two tools' only for their first ~1.8k / ~2.6k tokens. Cost ratios with no cache at all: 1.6× / 3.6×; with every input token cached: 0.90× / 1.15×, so koda would not be cheaper than opencode on these questions. On edit tasks opencode was cheaper. opencode's token counts for 2 of these runs are lower bounds (an unmetered request each). Cost is the DeepSeek list price on the peak basis. Small n, no significance tests. Full results including where koda trails: benchmarks/

text.tspan: paired against each tool, round by round

svg.text: opencode used less time and money than koda on edit tasks and over all rounds; Hermes Agent used more money
and tokens; koda used less than both only on short questions.
each value = median over rounds of tool ÷ koda for the same task and repetition, the three tools run concurrently in every round
a dot left of 1× means that tool used less than koda · lower is better in every row

svg.text: median of the same-round ratios · stem from 1×
KODA LEADS = both tools above 1× · KODA TRAILS = at least one tool below 1× · ALL EQUAL = both at 1×
Speed and calls: koda runs a router, a coder and a verifier one after another, plus a planner and a reviewer when used
(a median 20 model calls per edit run against 9 and 12.5), and a failed verification adds a second pass: 3 of 20 edit runs
(b1 r1 163 s, d1 r1 126 s, d1 r5 128 s; task medians 35.5 s and 78.6 s).
¹ Each run used a new, randomly named directory. koda's path-free prompts were cached almost whole across runs, the other two tools'
only for their first ~1.8k / ~2.6k tokens. Cost ratios with no cache at all: 1.6× / 3.6×; with every input token cached: 0.90× / 1.15×, so koda
would not be cheaper than opencode on these questions. On edit tasks opencode was cheaper.
opencode's token counts for 2 of these runs are lower bounds (an unmetered request each).
Run main-20260930 · 2026-09-30 12:13-12:42 UTC · deepseek-flash for all three tools, one API account
Cost = DeepSeek list price, peak basis (per 1M tokens: cache hit $0.006, miss $0.30, output $1.20); the runs were off-peak and billed at 50%
Paired = median of the same-round tool ÷ koda ratios, the three tools running concurrently in every round
Small n (5 or 3 runs per task and tool), no significance tests.
